import pathlib,os,subprocess,json,time,shutil
R=pathlib.Path('E:/PCControlAutonomyR41')
SHA='506f9a951f9b782e27b0d886e441b6747095e3fc'
REL=R/'releases'/SHA
CFG=R/'config.r41-integrated.json'
SRC=R/'START_R41_OBSERVER.cmd'
S=pathlib.Path(os.environ['APPDATA'])/'Microsoft/Windows/Start Menu/Programs/Startup'
ENTRY=S/'PCControl_R41_Observer.cmd'
if not REL.is_dir() or not CFG.is_file() or not SRC.is_file() or not S.is_dir():raise RuntimeError('R41_OBSERVER_BOOTSTRAP_NOT_READY')
if ENTRY.exists() or (R/'WATCHER_R41.json').exists():raise RuntimeError('R41_STARTUP_ALREADY_OWNED_ABORT')
cfg=json.loads(CFG.read_text('utf8'))
if cfg.get('mode')!='observe' or cfg.get('operatorApproved') is not False:raise RuntimeError('R41_ARMED_CONFIG_FORBIDDEN')
contents=SRC.read_text(encoding='utf8')
if '--dispatch' in contents or '--i-accept-real-send' in contents or '--watch' not in contents:raise RuntimeError('STARTUP_SCRIPT_NOT_READ_ONLY')
node=shutil.which('node')
if not node:raise RuntimeError('NO_NODE')
with ENTRY.open('x',encoding='utf8') as f:f.write('@echo off\r\ncall "'+str(SRC)+'"\r\n')
logs=R/'logs';logs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
fd=(logs/'observer.live.log').open('a',encoding='utf8')
flags=subprocess.DETACHED_PROCESS|subprocess.CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP
p=subprocess.Popen([node,str(REL/'bin/pc-autonomy-daemon.js'),'--config',str(CFG),'--watch'],cwd=str(REL),creationflags=flags,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=fd,stderr=fd,close_fds=True)
fd.close()
time.sleep(2.5)
running=p.poll() is None
status={'version':'r41.autostart.v1','source':SHA,'pid':p.pid,'runningAtInstall':running,'entry':str(ENTRY),'observerOnly':True,'sendEnabled':False}
(R/'WATCHER_R41.json').write_text(json.dumps(status,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
tail=(logs/'observer.live.log').read_text(encoding='utf8',errors='replace')[-1800:]
print(json.dumps({'mode':'READ_ONLY_LOGON_STARTUP','registered':True,'pid':p.pid,'processRunning':running,'root':str(R),'startupEntryName':ENTRY.name,'lastLog':tail[-900:],'noProviderSend':True,'otherScheduledTasksUnmodified':True},ensure_ascii=True)[:3400])
